items.text: Thank you for the opportunity to address the potential zoning change to allow an exception to the short-term housing ordinance for 1208 Briar Drive. We would like to be at the public hearing regarding this matter; however, we will be out of town on the date of the hearing. We would like for the attached letter to serve as our formal objection to the zoning change and request that it be read at the hearing and entered into the record. If you have any questions or need further comment, please contact me via phone or email.

First, I would like to know what prompted this zoning change request. The property has already been operating as a short-term rental property. If they have been operatingi without the required permit, I do not believe they should be rewarded with an exception to the ordinance.
